title: 日本ダービーにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Japanese Derby, the second race on our Triple Crown tour.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The venue feels tense and heavy. Tokai Teio tries to keep her spirits up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She states she'll win the Japanese Derby and heads off to the track… all for the sake of surpassing Symboli Rudolf!
